ETag.description: A weak validator of the aggregate version, e.g. `W/"3"`.

dwellThresholdMinutes.description: Per trailer kind (DRY_VAN, REEFER, FLATBED, CONTAINER); a kind without an entry is never alerted.

minimumSealClass.description: The lowest ISO 17712 class a seal may have at check-in and record-seal (I below S below H); null = no minimum, today's behaviour.

requireSecuringBeforeDoorWork.description: When true, door work starts only on a secured trailer (409 `trailer-not-secured` otherwise; ADR 0013). false (the default) is the behaviour before the interlock existed. A regulated site (OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178(k)(1)) sets it true; a later ADR may flip the default.

allowHazmatOnUnclassifiedSpots.description: When true, a trailer with a hazard class may take a spot whose kind is unknown at a site that has no HAZMAT spot (ADR 0014). false (the default) refuses it with 409 `placement-rule-violated`. Never lets a hazmat trailer onto a spot of another kind, nor onto an unclassified one where the site has a HAZMAT spot.

gate.description: The step that is refused (409 `inspection-required`, or `inspection-failed`) until a PASSED inspection of the template exists for the trailer's current visit. PRE_DOCK gates the move to a door, PRE_LOAD the start of door work on a trailer that is being loaded, PRE_DEPARTURE the check-out that takes the trailer. ON_DEMAND is never required.

purposes.description: Only visits with one of these purposes; empty = every purpose.

trailerKinds.description: Only trailers of one of these kinds; empty = every kind.

requiredInspections.description: The inspections a trailer needs before it docks, loads or leaves (ADR 0015); empty = none, the behaviour before them.

declared.description: False while the answer is the default policy of an undeclared site.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, a NUL byte, a missing or invalid Idempotency-Key, or an invalid path or query parameter.
